description: Mississippi Valley-type zinc-lead: replacement and open-space ore in platform dolostone, deposited by basin brines that orogenic uplift drove through the carbonate aquifer.

source.note: hot basinal brines (75–200 °C, 10–30 wt% NaCl; Leach et al. 2005; Garven 1985) from a subsiding sedimentary basin anywhere within the flow reach, not at the site; the field is the share of hot basin within brine_flow_km (regional.rs); full at 0.035, about 40,000 km² of hot basin spread within a 600 km reach (design)

driver.note: topography-driven flow from a rising orogen across the basin (Garven & Freeze 1984; Garven 1985; Bethke & Marshak 1990: 'topographic relief of the tectonic belt provided the dominant driving force'), during contraction (Leach et al. 2001); the field counts only ground rising now (regional.rs); full drive at 3.3 m/km, Garven & Freeze 1984's base case (a 1 km water-table drop over a 300 km basin)

pathway.note: faults, arches and basement highs focus the discharge (Bradley & Leach 2003: flexure-induced faults; design thresholds)
a platform on continental crust (Leach et al. 2010: platform carbonate sequences); design thresholds

trap.note: platform carbonates as aquifer and reactive host (Leach et al. 2010); a fifth of the column's top kilometre counts fully (design)

notes: Sizing: USGS OFR 2009-1252 (Singer, Berger & Moring 2009), model CAam (carbonate-hosted, amagmatic), n = 132, Table 2 p. 9: tonnage 0.93 / 10 / 86 Mt, Zn 1.7 / 5.1 / 12 %, Pb 0.19 / 1.5 / 5.0 %, Ag 0 / 0 / 37 g/t (unreported grades counted as zero); correlations from the text p. 8; the 2 km same-deposit rule p. 2. The report has no MVT model as such: 93 of its 132 CAam deposits are labelled MVT and 93 of the 105 MVT-labelled deposits fall in CAam. presence = n_reported / 132 counted in the report's database SedZn-PbTX.txt. The MVT-only table of SIR 2010-5070-A (Table 1) is in data/usgs/mvt_zn_pb.json extra. Cu and Au (9 and 3 of 132) are left out.

PLACEHOLDERS (not found in any USGS source): ore_density_t_m3 2.9 (dolostone with sulfides), density_per_1e5km2 1 / 5 / 20 (no USGS MVT deposit density exists; SIR 2010-5070-A gives district areas of 1,600–10,000 km² and Pine Point's 60 ore bodies in 1,600 km², which local densities far exceed), formation_depth_m 1000.
Design values: the curves' thresholds, integration_myr 5 (brine flushes are short: 0.5–5 Myr at Pine Point, Garven 1985), clustering, zoning, aspect, size multipliers.
Create stones (decisions file): dolostone (asurine → zinc) is the preferred host at 1.5, and the ore body turns its host to dolostone (hydrothermal dolomite).

Balance (P1-17 calibration, 2026-09-29): count_mult 20. With the placeholder density the permissive platforms of a 16k planet (1,000–25,000 km²) expect well under one deposit, so the family would be absent from most planets; 20 × gives a few per 500-Myr pipeline_quick_16k run, many of which the ledger then erodes (the playability pass guarantees essentials). Carbonate hosts stay scarce on the recorded history (STATUS.md, P1-17 partial: calibration).
